20 years on the Romanian IT market and still growing.
 Part of the HN Services Group, with offices in France, Spain, Portugal, and Luxembourg, HN Services Romania is about building real careers, not just filling roles.
 What you’ll find here:
 • Digital transformation projects with real impact
 • A wide range of technical roles across modern and legacy technologies (yes, COBOL is still very much alive)
 • Exposure to diverse industries and international envi ronments
 • Continuous growth through our in-house software development training center (HN Training Institute)
 💡We are currently looking for experienced professionals to deliver high-quality, stable, and resilient software solutions.
 Key Responsibilities 
Develop, maintain, and enhance applications on the AS400 / IBM i platform.
Analyze technical and functional requirements and implement appropriate solutions.
Perform debugging, testing, and troubleshooting of existing applications.
Participate in application maintenance and production support activities.
Collaborate with technical and functional teams in an international environment.
Contribute to code quality and technical documentation.
 Technical Skills 
Strong experience with AS400 / IBM i development.
Good knowledge of RPG / RPG IV / ILE RPG .
Experience with CL/CLLE .
Good knowledge of DB2 for i and SQL.
Experience with application maintenance, debugging, and performance optimization.
Knowledge of Git or other version control tools is a plus.
 Requirements 
Minimum 3 years of experience in AS400 development.
 French – B2 level or higher , with the ability to communicate effectively in a professional environment.
Good English communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaborate with distributed teams.
 Language: French (B2+) & English
 Only eligible candidates will be contacted for further information and start of the recruitment process.
